text: Mercy Health describes itself on its About Us page as 'one ministry' serving regions of Ohio and Kentucky, with a mission to 'extend the compassionate ministry of Jesus.' This page does not itself identify the organization as Catholic, does not mention Bon Secours Mercy Health or a 2018 merger, and does not state its nonprofit/tax status — those specific claims are not supported by this source and would need a different page or source to confirm.

source.name: Mercy Health: Why Mercy | About Us
source.quote: We are one ministry serving eight regions in Ohio and Kentucky, pursuing one Mission to improve the health of our communities.
